findings.evidence: The same file already provides `tensorMap_id` (l.238) and `tensorMap_comp` (l.251); Mathlib's `TensorProduct.congr` has `congr_symm`/`congr_refl`/`congr_trans`. Recoupling.lean's `*_symm_apply` proofs fall back on `Tensor.inductionOn` plus `simp` through `tensorCongr_symm_tmul`.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] tensorCongr_symm : (tensorCongr R H f g).symm = tensorCongr R H f.symm g.symm`, `@[simp] tensorCongr_refl`, `tensorCongr_trans`, and `@[simp] coe_tensorCongr`/`toLinearMap_tensorCongr` (= `tensorMap R H f.toLinearMap g.toLinearMap`). `tensorCongr_symm_tmul` then follows from them.
findings.issue: `tensorCongr` only has pointwise lemmas (`_apply`, `_tmul`, `_symm_tmul`). It lacks `tensorCongr_symm`, `tensorCongr_refl`, `tensorCongr_trans` and a `toLinearMap` lemma, so inverses of composite decompositions must be handled by tensor induction.

findings.evidence: Projection.lean l.49 (`clebschGordanProjection_apply`, no simp) and l.55/71/78 (`@[simp]` projection lemmas); `clebschGordanRecouplingEquiv_single_apply` has to cite `clebschGordanRightEquiv_symm_apply` explicitly in `simp only`.
findings.fix: Mark both `*_symm_apply` lemmas `@[simp]` so `(e.symm x) i j` rewrites to the projection composite, the form that the binary projection–inclusion simp lemmas act on.
findings.issue: `clebschGordanRightEquiv_symm_apply` and `clebschGordanLeftEquiv_symm_apply` turn channel extraction into composite projections but lack `@[simp]`, while their duals `clebschGordan{Left,Right}Equiv_single` have it. The binary layer orients toward projections: `clebschGordanProjection_apply` is not simp, but `clebschGordanProjection_equiv`/`_inclusion_self`/`_inclusion_of_ne` are.

summary: The new coproduct congruence `tensorCongr` is missing the lemmas that describe it as an equivalence (symm/refl/trans/toLinearMap), and the triple-decomposition inverse lemmas, the duals of the `@[simp]` `*_single` lemmas, lack `@[simp]`.
